resources.string: Hear stereo through two virtual speakers using measured SADIE II responses. Use headphones; crossfeed is disabled when this is on. HRTF supports PCM up to 96 kHz; higher rates bypass it.

Compare the three speaker angles with music already playing. These are generic responses; choose the one that sounds natural to you.
Restore bass and treble balance when you lower the app PCM volume.

Compensation is zero at the reference volume and reaches its maximum 20 dB below it. Uses the app volume control, independently of Android and DAC hardware volume. This is not a calibrated sound-pressure measurement. Output peak protection is active.
